Animal Company Simulator
A multiplayer VR game for Meta Quest
Animal Company Simulator is a fun, physics-based VR game where you run, climb, and interact in a shared world with other players. Buy items, explore, and cause chaos with friends.

About the Game
Animal Company Simulator is built for Meta Quest using GorillaLocomotion, giving players a natural and immersive movement experience. Play with up to 10 players in the same world, purchase items from vending machines, and collect rewards scattered around the map.

Features
Multiplayer — up to 10 players per room
Physics-based movement with GorillaLocomotion
In-game economy with a wallet system
Item spawning and collecting
Vending machines to spend your earnings
Cross-session progress saved to the cloud

How to Play
Put on your Meta Quest headset
Launch Animal Company Simulator
Log in with your Meta account
Join a public room or create a private one with friends
Move around using your hands and body
Collect items, earn money, and spend it at vending machines
